name: Kokoro TTS OpenAI-Compatible Speech API (API Key + Web UI)
description: Natural text-to-speech on CPU: OpenAI /v1/audio/speech, 70+ voices.

upstream.kokoro-fastapi: remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI v0.10.0 (Apache-2.0), image ghcr.io/remsky/kokoro-fastapi-cpu:v0.10.0 pinned by index digest; model hexgrad/Kokoro-82M v1.0 (Apache-2.0) baked into the image

KOKORO_API_KEY.description: API key for clients: send it as 'Authorization: Bearer {key}' (or xi-api-key / X-API-Key). 16-256 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ -.

KOKORO_USERNAME.description: Web player sign-in user name (letters, digits, . _ @ -).

KOKORO_PASSWORD.description: Web player sign-in password, generated at deploy. 12-72 characters; anything else locks the web player until you fix it.

PORT.description: Gateway port (healthcheck and public domain target).

KOKORO_API_KEY.description: The gateway's API key; Kokoro answers 401 to requests without it (/health stays open).

KOKORO_THREADS.description: Inference threads. auto = the service's CPU quota, capped at 8 (the host's core count would oversubscribe).

DEFAULT_VOICE.description: Voice used when a request names none (see GET /v1/audio/voices).

ENABLE_WEB_PLAYER.description: Serve the web player at /web/ (behind the gateway sign-in).

ENABLE_DEBUG_ENDPOINTS.description: Keep host and process introspection routes off.

ALLOW_DEV_UNLOAD.description: Keep the model unload/reload routes off.

ALLOW_LOCAL_VOICE_SAVING.description: Do not let callers write combined voices to disk (no volume).

MAX_INPUT_LENGTH.description: Characters one request may submit (upstream default 1,000,000).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time running syntheses get to finish on redeploy.
